headline: Every dashboard is green. Your gut says otherwise.
trigger: Go-live is within 90 days and a pilot, UAT, or dress rehearsal shows cracks.
pains: Training completion is high, but nobody has proven people can do the job
Managers and the project team tell you different stories
Everyone reporting on readiness has a stake in the answer
Too late to start a full OCM program from scratch
message: Training completion tells you who clicked through. It doesn’t tell you who can do the job on day one.
